title: GLOBAL
content:
GLOBAL
Mockumentary-commercial hybrid. A bright museum-style expo hall, warm wood-slat ceiling, soft even lighting. Style: crisp product-ad cinematography crossed with slapstick physical comedy. Premise: a Japanese salaryman tries "The Human Washing Machine" and the machine is far more enthusiastic than he expected.

LOCKS

Subject: Japanese man, early 40s, black suit, tie loosened, expressive comic face
Device: [@image1] white aerodynamic capsule body, mirror-chrome clamshell hood hinging open/shut like a beetle's wing case, dark contrast base panel reading "Science," rounded egg-shaped silhouette, small interior display screen, smooth reflective surfaces
Dialogue language: Japanese only, spoken by the man; no on-screen English except the product title card
Negatives: no real/named brands, no identifiable real person's likeness, no injury-implying content — comedic peril only
Restate at physical end: chrome-hood + white-pod silhouette must stay identical across all shots
Shot 1 — The Pitch (0:00–0:07)

[subject: man, tired, loosening his tie] + [he gestures proudly at the capsule, its chrome hood already raised open] + [space: pod centered on a showroom platform, hood catching the light] + [camera: slow push-in, static-feeling dolly] + [light: bright even hall lighting, glossy reflections on the chrome] + [audio: （upbeat quirky marimba jingle）{"これが新発明、ヒューマン洗濯機です！"} ] + end state: he's climbing into the capsule, one leg in, still smiling at camera
Shot 2 — Sealed In (0:07–0:13)

[subject: man now lying inside the pod] + [one observable action: the chrome hood lowers and seals shut with a comic thunk, his face pressed to the glass, panicking] + [camera: cut to static medium shot dead-on the hood] + [light: interior blue glow flickers on] + [audio: <mechanical thunk> {"ちょっと待って、待ってー！"} ] + end state: his palms are flat against the inside of the glass, eyes wide
Shot 3 — Bubble Chaos (0:13–0:21)

[subject: man inside sealed pod] + [one observable action: jets fire from hidden vents, foam and soap bubbles flood the capsule instantly, he flails and spins, cheeks puffed, hair full of suds] + [camera: handheld-feeling shake, quick push-in on the hood glass] + [light: interior flashes brighter with each jet burst] + [audio: <jet hiss><bubbling><comic boing> {"うわあああ、冷たい、冷たい！"} （music swells faster）] + end state: pod interior is fully whited out with foam, only one palm still pressed to the glass
Shot 4 — The Reveal (0:21–0:30)

[subject: man] + [one observable action: chrome hood pops open with a cartoon pop, he sits up squeaky clean, suit perfectly pressed, hair suspiciously glossy, throws a stiff thumbs-up then his arm wobbles] + [space: stray soap bubbles drifting up out of the open hood] + [camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot of the whole capsule] + [light: return to bright even hall lighting] + [audio: <pop><bubble float><light comic sting> {"さっぱりしたぁ…"} 【ヒューマン洗濯機】] + end state: he freezes mid-thumbs-up as one bubble lands and pops on his nose

GLOBAL  
Híbrido entre mockumentary y comercial. Un luminoso hall de exposición con estilo de museo, techo de listones de madera cálida y una iluminación suave y uniforme. Estilo: cinematografía nítida de anuncio de producto cruzada con comedia física slapstick. Premisa: un salaryman japonés prueba "The Human Washing Machine" y la máquina resulta mucho más entusiasta de lo que esperaba.

LOCKS

Sujeto: hombre japonés, principios de los 40, traje negro, corbata aflojada, rostro cómico y expresivo  
Dispositivo: [@image1] cuerpo de cápsula blanco y aerodinámico, capó abatible de espejo cromado que se abre y cierra como el estuche alar de un escarabajo, panel inferior oscuro de contraste con la palabra "Science", silueta redondeada en forma de huevo, pequeña pantalla interior, superficies lisas y reflectantes  
Idioma de los diálogos: solo japonés, hablado por el hombre; nada de inglés en pantalla salvo la tarjeta con el título del producto  
Negativos: sin marcas reales o con nombre, sin semejanza identificable de una persona real, sin contenido que sugiera lesiones — solo peligro cómico  
Reafirmar al final físico: la silueta de capó cromado + cápsula blanca debe permanecer idéntica en todas las tomas  

Toma 1 — La presentación (0:00–0:07)

[subject: man, tired, loosening his tie] + [he gestures proudly at the capsule, its chrome hood already raised open] + [space: pod centered on a showroom platform, hood catching the light] + [camera: slow push-in, static-feeling dolly] + [light: bright even hall lighting, glossy reflections on the chrome] + [audio: （upbeat quirky marimba jingle）{"これが新発明、ヒューマン洗濯機です！"} ] + end state: he's climbing into the capsule, one leg in, still smiling at camera  
Toma 2 — Sellado dentro (0:07–0:13)

[subject: man now lying inside the pod] + [one observable action: the chrome hood lowers and seals shut with a comic thunk, his face pressed to the glass, panicking] + [camera: cut to static medium shot dead-on the hood] + [light: interior blue glow flickers on] + [audio: <mechanical thunk> {"ちょっと待って、待ってー！"} ] + end state: his palms are flat against the inside of the glass, eyes wide  
Toma 3 — Caos de burbujas (0:13–0:21)

[subject: man inside sealed pod] + [one observable action: jets fire from hidden vents, foam and soap bubbles flood the capsule instantly, he flails and spins, cheeks puffed, hair full of suds] + [camera: handheld-feeling shake, quick push-in on the hood glass] + [light: interior flashes brighter with each jet burst] + [audio: <jet hiss><bubbling><comic boing> {"うわあああ、冷たい、冷たい！"} （music swells faster）] + end state: pod interior is fully whited out with foam, only one palm still pressed to the glass  
Toma 4 — La revelación (0:21–0:30)

[subject: man] + [one observable action: chrome hood pops open with a cartoon pop, he sits up squeaky clean, suit perfectly pressed, hair suspiciously glossy, throws a stiff thumbs-up then his arm wobbles] + [space: stray soap bubbles drifting up out of the open hood] + [camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot of the whole capsule] + [light: return to bright even hall lighting] + [audio: <pop><bubble float><light comic sting> {"さっぱりしたぁ…"} 【ヒューマン洗濯機】] + end state: he freezes mid-thumbs-up as one bubble lands and pops on his nose

fr.content:
GLOBAL  
Hybride mockumentaire-publicité. Une salle d’exposition lumineuse de style musée, plafond en lattes de bois chaleureuses, éclairage doux et uniforme. Style : une cinématographie nette de pub produit mêlée à une comédie physique burlesque. Principe : un salaryman japonais essaie « The Human Washing Machine » et la machine est bien plus enthousiaste qu’il ne l’avait prévu.

LOCKS

Sujet : homme japonais, début de la quarantaine, costume noir, cravate desserrée, visage comique expressif  
Appareil : [@image1] corps de capsule blanc aérodynamique, capot clamshell miroir-chrome s’ouvrant et se fermant sur charnière comme l’étui d’une aile de scarabée, panneau de base sombre contrasté portant « Science », silhouette arrondie en forme d’œuf, petit écran d’affichage intérieur, surfaces lisses et réfléchissantes  
Langue des dialogues : japonais uniquement, parlé par l’homme ; aucun anglais à l’écran sauf la carte-titre du produit  
Négatifs : aucune marque réelle ou nommée, aucune ressemblance identifiable avec une personne réelle, aucun contenu suggérant une blessure — uniquement un danger comique  
Rappeler à la fin physique : la silhouette capot chrome + capsule blanche doit rester identique dans tous les plans

Plan 1 — La présentation (0:00–0:07)

[sujet : homme, fatigué, desserrant sa cravate] + [il fait un geste fier vers la capsule, dont le capot chrome est déjà relevé] + [espace : capsule centrée sur une plateforme de showroom, le capot captant la lumière] + [caméra : lent push-in, mouvement de dolly presque statique] + [lumière : éclairage clair et uniforme de la salle, reflets brillants sur le chrome] + [audio : （jingle marimba entraînant et décalé）{"これが新発明、ヒューマン洗濯機です！"} ] + état final : il monte dans la capsule, une jambe à l’intérieur, tout en souriant encore à la caméra

Plan 2 — Enfermé dedans (0:07–0:13)

[sujet : homme maintenant allongé à l’intérieur de la capsule] + [une action observable : le capot chrome se rabat et se scelle avec un thunk comique, son visage plaqué contre la vitre, paniqué] + [caméra : coupe sur un plan moyen fixe, de face sur le capot] + [lumière : une lueur bleue intérieure s’allume en clignotant] + [audio : <thunk mécanique> {"ちょっと待って、待ってー！"} ] + état final : ses paumes sont à plat contre l’intérieur de la vitre, les yeux écarquillés

Plan 3 — Chaos de bulles (0:13–0:21)

[sujet : homme à l’intérieur de la capsule scellée] + [une action observable : des jets se déclenchent depuis des évents cachés, mousse et bulles de savon envahissent instantanément la capsule, il se débat et tourne sur lui-même, joues gonflées, cheveux pleins de mousse] + [caméra : tremblement façon caméra à l’épaule, push-in rapide sur la vitre du capot] + [lumière : l’intérieur clignote plus fort à chaque salve de jets] + [audio : <sifflement des jets><bouillonnement><boing comique> {"うわあああ、冷たい、冷たい！"} （la musique monte plus vite）] + état final : l’intérieur de la capsule est entièrement blanchi par la mousse, seule une paume reste encore plaquée contre la vitre

Plan 4 — La révélation (0:21–0:30)

[sujet : homme] + [une action observable : le capot chrome s’ouvre d’un pop de dessin animé, il se redresse, impeccable et parfaitement propre, costume parfaitement repassé, cheveux d’une brillance suspecte, lève un pouce raide puis son bras vacille] + [espace : quelques bulles de savon dérivent vers le haut en sortant du capot ouvert] + [caméra : lent recul vers un plan large de toute la capsule] + [lumière : retour à l’éclairage clair et uniforme de la salle] + [audio : <pop><bulles qui flottent><petit sting comique> {"さっぱりしたぁ…"} 【ヒューマン洗濯機】] + état final : il se fige au milieu du pouce levé tandis qu’une bulle atterrit sur son nez et éclate

--- CONTINUATION DU FIL ---

ko.content:
GLOBAL  
모큐멘터리-상업 광고 하이브리드. 밝은 박물관 스타일의 엑스포 홀, 따뜻한 우드 슬랫 천장, 부드럽고 고른 조명. 스타일: 선명한 제품 광고 촬영미학에 슬랩스틱 신체 코미디를 결합. 전제: 일본 샐러리맨이 "The Human Washing Machine"을 체험하는데, 기계가 그가 예상한 것보다 훨씬 더 열정적이다.

LOCKS

pt.content:
GLOBAL
Híbrido entre mockumentary e comercial. Um salão de exposição claro, com estilo de museu, teto com ripas de madeira em tom quente e iluminação suave e uniforme. Estilo: cinematografia limpa de anúncio de produto cruzada com comédia física pastelão. Premissa: um salaryman japonês experimenta “A Máquina de Lavar Humanos” e a máquina é muito mais entusiasmada do que ele esperava.

LOCKS

Subject: homem japonês, início dos 40 anos, terno preto, gravata afrouxada, rosto expressivo e cômico
Device: [@image1] corpo de cápsula branco e aerodinâmico, tampa clamshell espelhada em cromo abrindo e fechando como a carapaça de uma asa de besouro, painel inferior escuro com a palavra “Science”, silhueta arredondada em forma de ovo, pequena tela de exibição interna, superfícies lisas e reflexivas
Dialogue language: apenas japonês, falado pelo homem; nenhum inglês na tela, exceto o cartão de título do produto
Negatives: sem marcas reais ou nomeadas, sem semelhança identificável com pessoas reais, sem conteúdo que sugira ferimentos — apenas perigo cômico
Restate at physical end: a silhueta da tampa cromada + cápsula branca deve permanecer idêntica em todas as cenas
Shot 1 — The Pitch (0:00–0:07)

[subject: man, tired, loosening his tie] + [he gestures proudly at the capsule, its chrome hood already raised open] + [space: pod centered on a showroom platform, hood catching the light] + [camera: slow push-in, static-feeling dolly] + [light: bright even hall lighting, glossy reflections on the chrome] + [audio: （upbeat quirky marimba jingle）{"これが新発明、ヒューマン洗濯機です！"} ] + end state: he's climbing into the capsule, one leg in, still smiling at camera
Shot 2 — Sealed In (0:07–0:13)

[subject: man now lying inside the pod] + [one observable action: the chrome hood lowers and seals shut with a comic thunk, his face pressed to the glass, panicking] + [camera: cut to static medium shot dead-on the hood] + [light: interior blue glow flickers on] + [audio: <mechanical thunk> {"ちょっと待って、待ってー！"} ] + end state: his palms are flat against the inside of the glass, eyes wide
Shot 3 — Bubble Chaos (0:13–0:21)

[subject: man inside sealed pod] + [one observable action: jets fire from hidden vents, foam and soap bubbles flood the capsule instantly, he flails and spins, cheeks puffed, hair full of suds] + [camera: handheld-feeling shake, quick push-in on the hood glass] + [light: interior flashes brighter with each jet burst] + [audio: <jet hiss><bubbling><comic boing> {"うわあああ、冷たい、冷たい！"} （music swells faster）] + end state: pod interior is fully whited out with foam, only one palm still pressed to the glass
Shot 4 — The Reveal (0:21–0:30)

[subject: man] + [one observable action: chrome hood pops open with a cartoon pop, he sits up squeaky clean, suit perfectly pressed, hair suspiciously glossy, throws a stiff thumbs-up then his arm wobbles] + [space: stray soap bubbles drifting up out of the open hood] + [camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot of the whole capsule] + [light: return to bright even hall lighting] + [audio: <pop><bubble float><light comic sting> {"さっぱりしたぁ…"} 【ヒューマン洗濯機】] + end state: he freezes mid-thumbs-up as one bubble lands and pops on his nose
